annotation.title_clean: Building trust in data and AI: the new Data and AI Ethics Framework and self-assessment tool
annotation.title_en: Building trust in data and AI: the new Data and AI Ethics Framework and self-assessment tool
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Government Digital Service (GDS), UK Civil Service – Data in government blog (Hess-Rheingans, E.; Hawkes, L.; Gilburt, B.)
annotation.summary_en: UK Government Digital Service blog post announcing the refreshed Data and AI Ethics Framework and a new self-assessment tool for public-sector data and AI projects. It expands scope to AI and algorithmic technologies and adds principles on privacy, sustainability, societal impact and safety. No robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Framework renamed Data and AI Ethics Framework; scope expanded to AI and algorithmic technologies
Principles expanded to include privacy, environmental sustainability, societal impact and safety alongside fairness, accountability, transparency
New self-assessment tool to identify risks and impacts across project life cycle
Aligned with AI Playbook, ATRS and Model for Responsible Innovation
Refresh informed by feedback from over 100 government users
